SELECT storage.id, storage.name, storage.address, manager.id AS managerId, manager.name AS managerName, storage.created_at, createdBy.name AS createdBy, storage.updated_at, updatedBy.name AS updatedBy, remark FROM storage LEFT JOIN user manager ON storage.manager_id = manager.id LEFT JOIN user createdBy ON storage.created_by = createdBy.id LEFT JOIN user updatedBy ON storage.updated_by = updatedBy.id
storage.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND storage.is_deleted = 0
